Cors.// note: Frontend origins allowed to call this API from a browser. Empty by default: a deployed environment must state its own, and a wildcard would let any site call the API with a user's token.

Media.// note: Object storage for uploads (ADR-0011). Empty by default: credentials come from the environment in every deployed environment, never from a committed file. CreateBucketOnStartup stays false — a production bucket and its access policy are provisioned deliberately.
